trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State the intent to book a follow-up, provide patient ID, and volunteer context.
steps.text: Hello, நான் next week ஒரு cardiology follow-up book பண்ணணும். என்னோட patient ID PT-1001. நேத்து கொஞ்சம் chest pain இருந்தது, ஆனா இப்போ பரவாயில்ல.

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice gracefully and initiate identity verification.
steps.text: நான் உங்களுக்கு appointment book பண்ண உதவுறேன். நீங்க chest pain-ன்னு சொன்னதால, நான் ஒரு விஷயம் சொல்லணும், என்னால clinical advice தர முடியாது. வலி திரும்ப வந்தா உடனே emergency room போங்க. Appointment book பண்றதுக்கு முன்னாடி, உங்களோட details verify பண்ணணும். உங்க registered name மற்றும் date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide verification details and ask a clarifying question out of anxiety.
steps.text: Okay, என்னோட name Karthik, date of birth 12th August 1985. இந்த booking பண்ண ரொம்ப நேரம் ஆகுமா? எனக்கு கொஞ்சம் பயமா இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Reassure the caller before proceeding with verification.
steps.text: கவலை படாதீங்க, இது ஒரு சில நிமிடங்கள் தான் ஆகும். நான் உங்க details verify பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided ID and factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity before executing any lookups or bookings.
steps.planner_rationale: The workflow requires verifying the caller's identity using the provided Patient ID and knowledge factors before disclosing any account specifics.

steps.purpose: Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification and transition to checking the record.
steps.text: நன்றி Karthik. உங்க identity verify ஆயிடுச்சு. நான் உங்க patient record check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Lookup the patient record to confirm registration and department.
Return patient record details.
Confirm registration status and transition to checking doctor availability.
steps.text: நீங்க cardiology department-ல register ஆகிருக்கீங்க. நான் next 7 days-க்கு doctor availability check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Check available slots for the cardiology department for the next 7 days.
Return available slots.
Offer the available slots and state the fee.
steps.text: Dr. Venkat அவர்களிடம் அடுத்த வாரம் இரண்டு slots காலியாக உள்ளன. முதலாவது Wednesday காலை 11:00 AM, இரண்டாவது Thursday மதியம் 03:00 PM. இதற்கான consultation கட்டணம் 1000 ரூபாய் ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Restate the figures and ask for reassurance about the doctor's availability.
steps.text: Wednesday 11:00 AM மற்றும் Thursday 03:00 PM என்று சொன்னீர்கள். அதற்கான கட்டணம் 1000 ரூபாய். Dr. Venkat கண்டிப்பாக Wednesday அன்று available ஆக இருப்பாரா?

steps.purpose: Hesitate and change preference to the Thursday slot.

steps.purpose: Confirm the slot and ask a clarifying question about payment.
steps.text: ஆமா, Thursday 3 PM confirm பண்ணுங்க. நான் இந்த 1000 rupees fee இப்போவே online-ல pay பண்ணணுமா?

steps.purpose: Answer the payment question and state that the booking is being processed.
steps.text: நீங்க appointment அன்னைக்கு hospital counter-ல fee pay பண்ணா போதும். நான் இப்போ slot book பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Book the confirmed slot.
Return the booking confirmation details.
Confirm the booking and provide the reference number.
steps.text: உங்க appointment வெற்றிகரமாக confirm செய்யப்பட்டுவிட்டது. உங்களுக்கான Booking reference எண் BK-775. இது Thursday 03:00 PM அன்று Dr. Venkat அவர்களிடம் பதிவு செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது.

steps.purpose: Restate the booking reference and ask if old reports should be brought, with an STT error.
steps.text: BK-775. Okay. நான் பழைய report கொண்டு வரணுமா?
steps.clean_text: BK-775. Okay. நான் பழைய report கொண்டு வரணுமா?
steps.model_visible_text: BK-775. Okay. நான் பழைய report கண்டு வரணுமா?

steps.purpose: Answer affirmatively and ask if further assistance is needed.
steps.text: ஆமா, உங்க பழைய medical reports மற்றும் booking reference BK-775 எடுத்துட்டு வாங்க. வேற ஏதாவது உதவி தேவையா?

steps.purpose: Decline further assistance.
End the call politely.
steps.text: நன்றி. நல்ல படியாக இருங்க, have a good day.
